sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, amount, status, created_at, channel, region_code FROM orders_raw
SELECT order_id, customer_id, amount, created_at, channel, region_code FROM raw_orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'settled')
SELECT order_id, customer_id, amount, region_code FROM paid_orders WHERE amount > 0
SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS gross_amount, COUNT(order_id) AS paid_count FROM paid_orders GROUP BY customer_id
SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS paid_count FROM paid_orders GROUP BY customer_id
SELECT region_code, SUM(amount) AS region_amount FROM raw_orders GROUP BY region_code
SELECT order_id, customer_id, amount, region_code FROM paid_orders WHERE amount > 0
SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.amount - a.adjustment_amount AS net_total FROM paid_orders o JOIN order_adjustments a ON o.order_id = a.order_id
SELECT customer_id AS order_id, customer_id, amount, created_at, channel, region_code FROM raw_orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'settled')
